Name: REST
Segments:
- Experience developing REST APIs and Microservices.
- Integrate forms with enterprise applications, REST APIs, workflow platforms, content repositories, identity services, communication channels, and third-party solutions.
- Expect to work with languages and tools like Java, Python, Angular, Groovy, REST Services, GIT, PostgreSQL, Mongo, Athena, NiFi, Quarkus, and cloud platforms like Google Cloud, MS Azure, and AWS.

Name: Meta
Segments:
- Clients include major consumer-facing brands (American Express, Airbnb, Paramount Pictures), technology companies (Anthropic, Meta, Amazon), academic researchers (MIT, Yale, Stanford) and mission-aligned civic advocacy campaigns (e.g. on climate, human rights and elections).
- Hands-on experience with walled garden advertising APIs (Meta, Google, Amazon, TikTok) or the equivalent from the advertiser, agency, or DSP side
- Knowledge of digital metrics. Social Media and visualization tools (Preferably Brandwatch, SocialBakers-Emplifi, Meta for business, creator studio, TikTok, Twitter Ads, Youtube Analytics, Google Data Studio)

Name: A+
Segments:
- Certifications in relevant technical areas (e.g., CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft certifications, ITIL Foundation, HDI Support Center Manager)
- CompTIA A+, Network+, or related certifications are a plus.
- IT certifications (e.g., CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified IT Professional) are a plus.

Name: OLTP
Segments:
- Conocimiento de modelamiento OLTP y OLAP.
- Experience working with AWS-managed databases (e.g., Aurora or similar OLTP systems)
- Perform data migration / data transformation from OLTP to OLAP systems.

Name: SecOps
Segments:
- A hands-on DevOps and SecOps position as part of Unframe's Security and IT team, owning Security Vulnerabilities handling, Cloud infrastructure maintenance, the CI/CD and deployment automation that ships the platform into customer on-prem, cloud and hybrid environments.
- We are looking for a Senior Corporate Security Engineer to join the Corporate Security team in SecOps.
- Experience with Snowflake, Cortex, or Google SecOps is preferred.

Name: RPC
Segments:
- Proficiency in Java and/or Kotlin, and comfort working within a microservices environment (RPC frameworks, service IDLs, dependency injection)
- Strong distributed systems and infrastructure background: Java/Scala services, RPC and routing layers, configuration systems, Kubernetes-based microservices, and multi-cloud or multi-region deployments
- Strong background in distributed systems design, including RPC frameworks, queuing, RPC batching, sharding, memory partitioning

Name: Oracle Fusion
Segments:
- Build and maintain automated data pipelines extracting financial data from Oracle Fusion Cloud (GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets)
- Experience with Oracle Fusion, Oracle Financials, or a comparable enterprise ERP platform.
- Integrate enterprise systems: Work with REST APIs, JSON, databases, files and connectors to integrate with enterprise systems such as Oracle Fusion and automate end-to-end processes

Name: MM
Segments:
- Financial & Integrated Systems Fluency: Strong understanding of core SAP FI/CO modules (GL, AP, AR) and their integration points with Project Systems (PS) and Procurement (MM) to support capital accounting.
- Fibre & optical infrastructure (SM/MM, DWDM/CWDM)
- The Senior SAP MM Procurement Consultant provides senior level configuration management support for SAP procurement and materials processes.

Name: Intercom
Segments:
- Manage primary and backup internet paths, contribution feeds, SRT or equivalent transport, return video, intercom, confidence monitoring and streaming outputs.
- Experience with Intercom Fin or similar conversational AI platforms.
- It’s an exciting time at Intercom — especially within our Deployment Services team.

Name: Reuters
Segments:
- Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, SQL, Salesforce, Jira, Bloomberg, Thomson Reuters, or other common financial services systems and applications.
- Reuters: Driverless vehicles on limited routes bump along despite US robotaxi scrutiny
- Build and maintain strong relationships with financial and institutional media across Bloomberg, Reuters, FT, WSJ, and other key capital markets and crypto trade press

Name: FW
Segments:
- Working knowledge of C or C++ for embedded FW
- Participate in interdepartmental processes such as Drawing Release, Work Instruction Release, FW Release.
- Principal Embedded SW/FW Engineer (Bringup) - Austin, Tx, USA

Name: JNCIP
Segments:
- JNCIA/JNCIP or CCNA/CCNP certifications
- Industry-standard certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, JNCIS, or JNCIP.
- Relevant experience or certification (e.g. CCNP or JNCIP Data centre, Enterprise or Service provider)

Name: Raspberry
Segments:
- A personal project involving a Raspberry Pi, Arduino, microcontroller, or home automation
- Experience with embedded platforms (i.e. ESP32, STM, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, etc.)
- Implement robust, portable firmware using C/C++ for ARM-based microcontrollers and SBCs (e.g., STM32, NXP, Raspberry Pi-class devices).

Name: NI
Segments:
- Salary sacrifice pension with matched employer contributions up to 5% + NI savings
- Ces outils ne prennent pas de décisions d'embauche ni de décisions entièrement automatisées concernant votre candidature – toutes les décisions sont prises par nos équipes.
- Demonstrated experience in working with NI hardware (PXIe-RT, cRIO, and cDAQ) and coding with real-time and FPGA modules.

Name: Dynamo
Segments:
- Our team also works closely with the open source community, contributing to and leveraging projects like SGLang, vLLM, and NVIDIA Dynamo to push the boundaries of inference performance and efficiency.
- Familiarity with parametric and computational design tools (e.g., Grasshopper, Dynamo) to explore and optimize complex forms, workflows, or performance outcomes.
- Experience with LLM inference serving engines and technologies, e.g. vLLM, SGLang, Mooncake, NIM, Dynamo, LMCache.

Name: MISRA
Segments:
- Experience building automotive or safety-critical systems using qualification methods and processes such as MISRA, ASPICE, and ISO 26262.
- Familiarity with coding safety standards (e.g. MISRA-C).
- High-Rel Coding Standards & Frameworks: Familiarity with safety-critical, mission-assurance software development standards, or common flight architectures (e.g., NASA cFE/cFS, MISRA C/C++, DO-178C, or NASA NPR 7150.2).

Name: Warp
Segments:
- Intuition about the latency and throughput characteristics of CUDA graph launch, tensor core arithmetic, warp-level synchronization, and asynchronous memory loads
- Deep understanding of GPU architecture and performance: tensor cores, warp/occupancy tuning, the memory hierarchy and bandwidth, NVLink/PCIe, and profiling with Nsight Compute/Systems.
- Among the products powered by this technology is Dedicated Egress IP Connectivity, WARP, Cloudflare One/Zero Trust, and Cloudflare's egress proxy for the iCloud Private Relay product.

Name: Citadel
Segments:
- We’ve turned down opportunities like Stanford PhD programs and Y Combinator in order to pursue this goal, and we have experience doing AI research and engineering at places like Harvard, MIT, Citadel, Datadog, and McKinsey QuantumBlack (to name a few).
- Our team includes alumni of Two Sigma, Citadel Securities, Flow Traders, Tower Research, PDT Partners, SIG, and other top quantitative firms.
- Our early hires include an MIT PhD with 21,000+ Physics/ML/Stats citations, a Datadog engineering manager who led their GenAI observability team, a Citadel quant with a huge open-source presence, and more.

Name: JIT
Segments:
- Automate Access Reviews, entitlement packages, and JIT access using Graph API/PowerShell.
- OPA, ISPM & Zero Standing Privilege: Lead OPA, ISPM, and Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP) initiatives — design privileged session access, Just-In-Time (JIT) elevation, break-glass emergency access, identity security vulnerability detection, and tiering models for Tier 0/Tier 1 systems.
- Own access management, including Conditional Access, phishing-resistant MFA, and privileged access on a Zero Trust model, with least-privilege by default, just-in-time (JIT) elevation, and enforcement confirmed on every access path rather than only saved.

Name: Linux CLI
Segments:
- Experience using the Linux CLI and Linux Tools
- Deep familiarity with IP networking, SNMP, DHCP, PoE, Linux CLI, and basic system administration
- Experience with OS installation, Linux CLI and network setup
